quotes: You will not use the data for any purpose other than for scientific purposes or in support of measures or decisions concerning any particular establishment, enterprise, economic entity or other undertaking.
You will not disclose or otherwise employ the data for commercial purposes.

You will refrain from any attempt to de-anonymise the data, and you will not combine the data with data from other databases containing information on individual establishments or enterprises with that aim in mind.
The data source must be cited as: 'EC/ECB Survey on the access to finance of enterprises'. ... 'This paper uses data from the EC/ECB Survey on the access to finance of enterprises'.
You will send a copy of your research work based on SAFE data to the ECB by email to: survey.accesstofinance@ecb.europa.eu
